source_notes.label: Fuel loading and powder growth
source_notes.summary: The authors attribute smaller particles and a narrower distribution at the higher sucrose loading to greater gas evolution that hinders coalescence and growth. This is an interpretation of the 1A/2A comparison, not a quantified gas flow or combustion temperature.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 2, TEM size-distribution discussion

source_notes.label: Annealing purity has a documented exception
source_notes.summary: The detailed XRD analysis reports residual Mn2O3 for 0.5A, which is excluded from further measurements. Only 1A and 2A are described as single-spinel patterns. Broad abstract/conclusion statements about pure annealed products do not erase this exception.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 1–2, 4, Abstract, Figure 1 discussion and conclusion

source_notes.label: Lithium-rich composition from different observations
source_notes.summary: TG/reference correlation gives x=0.05 in Li1+xMn2−xO4, lattice-parameter correlation gives x=0.06, and electrochemical capacity gives an estimated Li1.04Mn1.96O4. These are distinct author-derived composition estimates, not independently refined exact site coordinates.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 3–4, Thermal, chemical and electrochemical composition analyses

source_notes.label: Transport mechanisms depend on temperature
source_notes.summary: The authors fit the 2A-derived pellet above 180 K using nearest-neighbor small-polaron hopping, and below 180 K using variable-range hopping. Model parameters are not new preparation variants; a separately prepared pellet is not assigned the powder TEM diameter.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 3, Figure 4 and equations 2–3

source_notes.label: Rate capability and cycling interpretation
source_notes.summary: Higher current is interpreted as restricting lithium exchange to the outer particle region. The authors relate the small-particle sample’s higher high-rate capacity to its size and its slow capacity fade to lithium excess. The solid-state comparator lacks a complete preparation in the supplied article.
source_locators: Main PDF p. 4, Figures 6–7 and rate/cycling discussion

source_notes.label: Separate analytical and cell preparation
source_notes.summary: The three-hour impedance-pellet sinter is distinct from the one-hour powder anneal. Battery current schedules are property conditions, not new powder recipes. Complete instrument, composition and model contexts are available in the source-context data.

claims.label: General summary
claims.statement: Abstract and concluding wording summarize annealing as yielding single-phase material.

claims.label: Sample-specific XRD
claims.statement: The detailed discussion and Figure 1d retain Mn2O3 in 0.5A and exclude it from further measurements.
claims.locator: Main PDF p.2, Figure 1d and adjacent text

evidence_conflicts.handling: Use the sample-specific impurity assignment for 0.5A. Do not label every annealed branch pure.

claims.label: Thermal estimate
claims.statement: TG onset/reference correlation gives x=0.05 and Li1.05Mn1.95O4.

claims.label: Lattice correlation
claims.statement: The source gives x=0.06 from the cubic lattice parameter versus composition relationship.

claims.label: Electrochemical estimate
claims.statement: First discharge corresponds to 0.88 Li and an estimated Li1.04Mn1.96O4.
claims.locator: Main PDF p.4, first-cycle capacity analysis

evidence_conflicts.handling: Retain the three evidence/model contexts in parallel; no averaging or assertion of measured exact occupancy.

claims.label: Printed frequency
claims.statement: The source prints an optical phonon frequency of 1.8 × 10−13 s−1 in the equation 2 explanation.
claims.locator: Main PDF p.3, paragraph below equation 2

evidence_conflicts.handling: Retain the literal exponent as a source model-context caveat. Do not silently correct it, treat it as a new measured frequency, or execute the model as validated code.
